generator.name: normal-duel-perft
generator.seededSelection: initialize from uint32 seed; advance before each selection; filter canonical ascending legal actions to walls only; choose walls[state%walls.length]; modulo bias is intentional and no rejection sampling is used

semantics.deduplication: none; count every legal action-tree occurrence
semantics.countType: safe integer only; traversal rejects counts above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
semantics.nodeBudget: state visits use a conservative MAX_PERFT_NODES default; explicit maxNodes may opt in up to MAX_PERFT_NODES_HARD_CAP, and traversal rejects before exceeding the selected deterministic cap
